RNN.source: Previous joint next-day validation selection; not the per-target independent smoke windows

LSTM.source: Previous joint next-day validation selection; not the per-target independent smoke windows

schedule.trigger: 5 complete epochs with no new global joint-val checkpoint; epoch improvement based on any step beating global joint-val best by1e-5
schedule.continuation: Continue current weights and AdamW moments; no rewind, no optimiser restart; transition after completed epoch affects next update

protocol.selection: One joint-val checkpoint per seed; mean joint-val across seeds selects policy per family; test only monitored
protocol.loss: Equal mean of three targets standardised by train-only scales; train/val/test always eval mode without dropout or added penalty
protocol.logging: Every optimizer step: complete train/val/test joint+3 components, LR/WD/dropout/stage/effective LR*WD; separate event audit
protocol.precision: float32; AMP/TF32 off; deterministic CUDA/cuDNN; same initialisation/shuffle seeds as old study

RNN.criterion: Mean joint validation only; test not used

LSTM.criterion: Mean joint validation only; test not used
